get.description: Read several Application details identified by their unique Company ID.

parameters.name: Company-Id
parameters.description: Kini ID of the Company

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page.

count.description: Total number of records available across all pages

next.description: URL to the next page of results

previous.description: URL to the previous page of results

id.description: Kini ID of the application

job.description: Kini ID of the job applied for (either job or external_job_id is required)

company.description: Kini ID of the company offering the job

external_job_id.description: Job's ID in external ATS systems, used for integrations (either job or external_job_id is required)

partner.description: Kini ID of the partner involved in the application

partner_application_id.description: External ID of the application in the partner's system (e.g. Jobboard)

partner_company_id.description: External ID of the company in the partner's system (e.g. ATS)

partner_job_id.description: External ID of the job in the partner's system (e.g. Jobboard)

agency.description: Kini ID of the agency distributing the application

agency_job_id.description: External ID of the job in the agency's system

gender.description: Applicant's gender. Enum: MALE (Male), FEMALE (Female), DIVERSE (Diverse), NOT_SPECIFIED (Not Specified).

language.description: Applicant's preferred language as an ISO 639-1 code (e.g. 'en', 'de')

skills.description: An array representing the applicant's skills

social_links.description: Social media links as key-value pairs where key is the platform name and value is the profile URL

id.description: ID of the screening question, must match the ID of a screening question in the company's ATS

answer_type.description: Answer type of the screening question

type.description: Attachment type. Possible values: `cv` (CV), `cover-letter` (Cover Letter), `photo` (Photo), `other` (Other Attachments).

content_type.description: MIME type of the attachment. Enum: application/msword (Doc), application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document (Docx), image/jpeg (Jpeg), application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text (Odt), application/pdf (Pdf), text/plain (Plain Text), image/png (Png), application/rtf (Rtf), application/octet-stream (Other).

attachments.description: List of attachments provided by the applicant

channel.description: External posting channel from which the application was received

sync_status.description: Indicates the current state of the application synchronization to the company's ATS. Enum: SUCCESS (Sync Successful), EXPECTED_FAILURE (Sync Failed Expectedly, No Action Needed), FAILURE (Sync Failed), NOTSENT (Sync Not Triggered).

failure_error.description: Error message if the application synchronization failed

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the application was first created

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the application was last updated

post.description:
Configure the Company's integration in a single call: store the integration credentials, switch on the features the partner is entitled to, and optionally update the Company's own master data.

Which keys `config` accepts depends on the integration and on the partner's entitlements — unknown keys are rejected with `400`. Ask your Kini contact for the field list of the integration you are wiring up.

Existing configuration for the same company and integration is overwritten, so the call is safe to repeat.

Unlike the rest of the API, this endpoint also accepts a Magic Link token instead of an API key — pass it as the `token` query parameter. That lets a company admin complete their own setup through a link, without ever being issued credentials. A Magic Link token is consumed by the call and cannot be reused.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique Kini ID of the company

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Magic Link token. Supply this instead of an API key to let a company admin configure their own integration. Single use.

parameters.name: Company-Id
parameters.description: Kini ID of the company the key is associated with. Optional here — the company is already identified by the path parameter.

integration.description: Slug of the integration to configure, e.g. `personio` or `softgarden`

config.description: Integration settings, keyed by field path. Keys under `credentials.` are written to the secret store and never returned by the API; all other keys are stored as plain configuration. Required fields differ per integration.

company_data.description: Optional partial update of the Company itself. Accepts the same fields as [Update Company](/api/patch-companies-id).

400.description: Unknown or missing `config` fields, or invalid `company_data`

403.description: No access to the company, or the Magic Link is invalid, expired, or already used

post.description:
Create a clickout link that signs the user in and drops them on the promote page of a single job, ready to book reach for it.

The job is looked up by its `external_job_id` within the company. Kini refreshes the job from the ATS first, and creates the job if it does not exist yet, so the link also works for a job your system has only just published.

parameters.name: Company-Id
parameters.description: Kini ID of the company the key is associated with

email.description: Email address of the user the link is issued for. A shop user is created and added to the company on first use.

external_job_id.description: The job's ID in your system. Must be unique within the company.

product_type.description: Preselect a tab on the promote page. Enum: single (single job bookings), campaign (campaigns).

data.description: Clickout URL. Signs the user in and lands them on the target page. Valid for one hour.

403.description: Company is not set up for the shop, or the email already belongs to another organisation

408.description: Refreshing the job from the ATS timed out

409.description: More than one job matches `external_job_id` in this company

502.description: Refreshing the job from the ATS failed
